- Project is a Spring Boot application using Spring Cloud Stream/Data Flow
- Existing test infrastructure exists but needs extension

technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot Test and JUnit 5 for acceptance test implementation
Leverage Testcontainers for external system dependencies (HDFS, SMTP server, etc.)
Follow existing project testing conventions and CI pipeline configuration
Implement tests as integration tests that validate end-to-end module behavior
Use parameterized tests for multiple input scenarios per module
Ensure tests are hermetic and can run in parallel in CI environment
assumptions: Project is a Spring Cloud Stream / Spring Cloud Data Flow application with existing module implementations
Each module (json-tuple, script, scripts, splitter, gauge, aggregate-counter, field-value-counter, hdfs-dataset, mail) has a well-defined public interface
Existing CI pipeline (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins) is configured and can run integration tests
Testcontainers library is available or can be added as test dependency
Development team has experience with Spring Boot testing and Testcontainers
No major refactoring of module code is required to enable testability
External dependencies (HDFS, mail server) can be containerized for testing
Acceptance tests focus on functional behavior, not performance/load testing

activities.activity_name: Analyze module interfaces and define test scenarios
activities.activity_description: Review each of the 9 modules' APIs, input/output contracts, and edge cases. Document acceptance criteria and test scenarios for json-tuple, script, scripts, splitter, gauge, aggregate-counter, field-value-counter, hdfs-dataset, and mail modules.

activities.activity_name: Set up test infrastructure and Testcontainers configuration
activities.activity_description: Configure Testcontainers for HDFS (for hdfs-dataset sink), SMTP server (for mail sink), and any other external dependencies. Create shared test base classes, test utilities, and common fixtures. Ensure integration with existing build system (Maven/Gradle).

activities.activity_name: Implement acceptance tests for processor modules
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests for json-tuple processor, script processor, scripts processor, and splitter processor. Cover happy paths, error handling, boundary conditions, and data transformation correctness. Use parameterized tests for multiple input variations.

activities.activity_name: Implement acceptance tests for gauge sink module
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests for gauge sink module covering metric reporting, gauge value updates, tag handling, and integration with metrics backend (Micrometer/Prometheus).

activities.activity_name: Implement acceptance tests for aggregate-counter sink module
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests for aggregate-counter sink covering counter increments, aggregation windows, dimension/tag handling, and persistence/export behavior.

activities.activity_name: Implement acceptance tests for field-value-counter sink module
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests for field-value-counter sink covering field extraction, value counting, time-windowed aggregations, and query/retrieval of counted values.

activities.activity_name: Implement acceptance tests for hdfs-dataset sink module
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests for hdfs-dataset sink using Testcontainers HDFS. Cover file writing, partitioning, format serialization (Parquet/ORC/Avro), schema evolution, and failure recovery scenarios.

activities.activity_name: Implement acceptance tests for mail sink module
activities.activity_description: Write acceptance tests for mail sink using Testcontainers SMTP server (e.g., MockMock or GreenMail). Cover email composition, templating, attachment handling, recipient resolution, and error handling for mail delivery failures.

activities.activity_name: Integrate tests into CI pipeline and verify execution
activities.activity_description: Configure CI pipeline to run new acceptance tests on every build. Verify test execution in CI environment, fix any flakiness, configure timeouts and resource limits. Ensure test reports are published.

activities.activity_name: Document test coverage and create maintenance guidelines
activities.activity_description: Document which modules are covered, test scenarios, how to run tests locally, how to add new test cases, and troubleshooting guide for CI failures. Update project README or testing documentation.
